headline: KCR @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 3.35 at CHW 3.65, with a projected total of 7.00. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: KCR moved -1.23 runs while CHW moved -0.15, changing the projected margin by -1.08 runs. The projected total fell -1.39, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +12.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Noah Schultz has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Bobby Witt Jr., Maikel Garcia, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Luisangel Acuña, Munetaka Murakami because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
